FN-9JISNMB-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 340
Committee: Transportation and Energy Sponsor: Senator Clyde Chambliss
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/11/2026
Senate Bill 340 could increase the financial obligations of operators of public or private
underground facilities by an undetermined amount dependent upon the costs incurred for project
delays resulting from incomplete locate requests by operators within the specific amount of
time.
